test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word**

OBESE
solution: The correct answer is '**Skinny**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Obese**' is '**Skinny**'. • **Obese**: (used about people) very fat, in a way that is not healthy. [(व्‍यक्ति) बहुत मोटा, स्‍थूलकाय (जो स्‍वस्‍थ होने का लक्षण नहीं)] • *Example: **Obese** patients are advised to change their diet.* • **Skinny**: (used about a person) too thin. [(व्‍यक्ति) दुबला-पतला; सींकिया] • *Example: At school, I was fairly **skinny** and undersized.* **Correct Answer:__** *Skinny.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Rude**: not polite. [अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)] • **Paunchy**: having a large or protruding belly. (एक बड़ा या फैला हुआ पेट होना) • **Cute**: attractive; pretty. (आकर्षक; सुंदर) 35:Tc1a, The correct answer is **'have been attacking'.**
